Review: I had a horrible one night stay at your property. Power was out for couple of hours early morning, sleep disturbed, no power back up. The food was horrible, I mean there’s bad food and then there’s over priced horrible food. I paid 640 rupees for chilli paneer, a sandwich and lemonana. Chill paneer had more corn flower than paneer, it was thick beyond understanding. The sandwich was very poorly made, bread looked so sad. No chips with it, even though it was priced high. Lemonan was good. It felt like the food was just being pushed from the kitchen, no one checking for quality. Road side food is more tasty and fresh. The toilet faucets had earthing. The roof top restaurants looked open in the pictures but was deserted in reality. The staff is friendly but that can’t be the only good thing you have to offer. There were not enough fans in the pool area for all guests. The fan we had was turned around for another guest by a staff without even considering our discomfort, we were sweating. Why were we treated like second class guests? When asked for a fan the guy said “main kuch jugaad karta hoon” which never happened. The infrastructure is poorly developed for you to be running a professional hostel. If you’re not fully operational then don’t charge people high amount of money like its busy season. This was my worst ever Zostel stay ever, before booking I had hoped the brand was up to standards. And I’m glad I only booked it for one night. Very very bad value for money. I met other people who voiced the same concern about deteriorating quality of Zostel Pushkar. Please do something about it, and please ask your staff to get high later, first run a successful show where the guests are taken care of first, the quality of service should justify the prices asked. Thanks
